Probably yes, but only Play Console can confirm it. Main got R8 code shrinking on 2026-11-12, with the Expo 58 update. It also keeps the speech model's code safe. That is about a day ago. It only reaches people in a new store build. I saw no Android build with it yet, but I read only part of the build list. The Play warning should clear after such a build goes up. The deadline is February 2027.

What shrinking can affect: voice detection and noise clean-up, recording and playback, QR scanning, the local database and sync, the checksum code, notifications and secure storage. If the speech model failed to load, the recorder would quietly fall back to older rules.

Testing: main's notes say a release build on an emulator signed in, synced and opened the recorder with the speech model loaded. That does not cover everything. Nobody has yet tested recording and playing a take, voice detection on real speech, QR scanning or notifications on a shrunk build. Do that on a release build before the next store build ships, and confirm Play gets the crash map.

I still recommend closing my change. Please answer the open question.
